pages.text: Casting a Technique requires:$(li)wearing a Curse Core with the corresponding Technique trait$(li)enough Cursed Energy (Soul Energy covers the shortfall when it runs out)$(li)not being under Technique Burnout$(br2)$(bold)Shrine / Blood Manipulation (multi-move Techniques)$(): press $(bold)F (the Reversal key)$() to cycle to the next move, and press the $(bold)Technique Release key$() to cast the selected move.$(br2)$(bold)Instant Techniques$() (moves such as Dismantle / Cleave and Piercing Blood / Convergence / Supernova): press the Technique Release key to fire them at your target or in the direction you face.$(br2)$(bold)Charged moves$() (Hearth Ignition): hold the key to charge (a flame arrow appears in your main hand) and release to fire.$(br2)$(bold)Switching Techniques$(): when your core has multiple Techniques, press the $(bold)Switch Technique$() key (default X) to cycle through them. The HUD in the top-left corner shows the current Technique, and the release key only casts the currently selected Technique.$(br2)In Creative mode, casting costs no Cursed Energy.

$(bold)Technique Reversal$(): some Techniques have a corresponding $(bold)reversal$() (e.g. Limitless: Blue → Red). While equipped with such a Technique, press the $(bold)Technique Reversal key$() (default F) to cast its reversal.$(br2)Combination: while charging Blue, press the Reversal key (F) to combine both into "$(l:techniques/wuliang_cang)Hollow Purple$()" and fire it immediately.$(br2)See each Technique's own entry to find out whether it has a reversal.
